##### Project general facts

Marbella Villas is an exceptional collection of prime, bespoke beachfront homes offering spacious luxury villas and townhouses within a secure gated community. Residents can choose from a wonderful range of 2, 3, 4 and 5 bedroom options, each thoughtfully designed to deliver extraordinary comfort and a truly relaxing waterfront lifestyle. Built upon elegant modern Mediterranean influences blended with a distinctly Emirati ambience, these homes create the perfect setting to unwind and enjoy everyday living at its very best.

The community is rich with world-class amenities, headlined by an exclusive residents' clubhouse featuring separate gyms with state-of-the-art equipment, two temperature-controlled outdoor pools, and a fully operational cafe with a wide array of refreshments. Families and friends can enjoy waterfront sun loungers, inviting terraces, and a dedicated kids' play area, alongside a vibrant array of dining, retail, and entertainment options set among beautiful promenades, walkways, parks, and events spaces. With multiple sports and leisure facilities and the five-star services of a neighbouring luxury hotel resort and spa close at hand, this is an ideal destination to socialise, work, rest, and play.

Every home is crafted to include bright, modern living spaces complemented by a stylish contemporary kitchen that makes entertaining a pleasure. Generous layouts thoughtfully incorporate a maid's and driver's room, a private garden, and dedicated parking, ensuring both elegance and everyday practicality. Many residences are further elevated by exceptional roof terraces that offer iconic views, delivering the ultimate blend of refined finishes and effortless indoor-outdoor living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled along the picturesque coastline of Ras Al Khaimah, Hayat Islands boasts a stunning waterfront setting that's second to none. Residents here are treated to breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, with pristine beaches just steps away. The serene sound of lapping waves and the panoramic vistas create an atmosphere of tranquility and relaxation.

The community is renowned for its world-class amenities and facilities. Residents can indulge in a range of leisure activities, from swimming in infinity pools that seem to merge with the sea to working out in state-of-the-art fitness centers. There are also dedicated spaces for relaxation, including lush parks and waterfront promenades, perfect for enjoying leisurely walks or picnics.

Hayat Islands offers a vibrant culinary and entertainment scene. The waterfront promenade is dotted with cafes and restaurants serving a diverse array of cuisines, making it the perfect place for dining al fresco while enjoying the stunning views. Whether you're looking for a romantic dinner or a family-friendly outing, there's something for everyone. While Hayat Islands provides a serene escape, it's also conveniently connected to the rest of Ras Al Khaimah and the UAE. Major highways and transportation links make it easy to access the city center, airports, and neighboring emirates, ensuring that you're never far from the excitement and amenities of the region.
